papers.title: TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Open-world robotic mobile manipulation requires acting in physical environments with only partial information. While recent Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) agents show strong open-world reasoning capabilities, existing architectures that rely on direct tool calling struggle with geometric uncertainty and thus are limited to fully-observable tabletop environments. In contrast, Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems can solve long-horizon tasks under partial observability but incur high computational costs and require closed worlds. We propose \textbf{TAMPAgent}, an agentic planning framework that unifies the reasoning of LVLMs with the structured constraint satisfaction of TAMP systems. We endow an LVLM agent with a belief-space planning model operating over an extensible API of perception, planning, and control tools. The agent formulates a partial task plan composed of parameterized observation and execution actions, which is subsequently completed using classical search algorithms. After extracting the plan's geometric constraints, the agent leverages its tool API to bind valid parameter values, satisfying feasibility requirements and producing an executable motion plan. Upon execution, the agent continuously updates its belief history and repeats this closed-loop process by interleaving observation and manipulation actions. Evaluated across complex household mobile manipulation tasks on Rainbow Y1 and Unitree G1 platforms, TAMPAgent significantly outperforms direct tool-calling agentic baselines, demonstrating that integrating TAMP constraint satisfaction into agentic planning loops is essential for unstructured, partially observable environments.

ai_summary.problem: 开放世界移动操作需要在部分可观测和几何不确定的环境中完成长时序任务，现有LVLM智能体直接调用工具难以处理几何不确定性，而TAMP方法虽能处理部分可观测性但计算成本高且依赖封闭世界。
ai_summary.method: 提出TAMPAgent框架，将LVLM的开放世界推理与TAMP的结构化约束满足相结合；LVLM智能体在可扩展的感知、规划和控制工具API上维护信念空间规划模型，先生成由参数化观测和执行动作组成的部分任务计划，再通过经典搜索和工具API绑定满足几何约束的有效参数，并在执行中持续更新信念历史、交替观测与操作形成闭环。
ai_summary.result: 在Rainbow Y1和Unitree G1平台上的复杂家庭移动操作任务中，TAMPAgent显著优于直接工具调用的智能体基线，表明将TAMP约束满足融入智能体规划循环对非结构化、部分可观测环境至关重要。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将LVLM智能体推理与TAMP信念空间约束满足统一到一个闭环规划框架中，使智能体能够在部分可观测的移动操作场景中生成可执行运动计划。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了LLM/LVLM智能体与经典任务运动规划结合解决具身智能中长时序、部分可观测操作问题的潜力，对具身智能体和机器人规划研究有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Align Once to Explain: Feature Alignment for Scalable B-cosification of Foundational Vision Transformers
papers.abstract: Foundational vision models have become the de facto standard for many vision tasks due to their strong performance. However, they are notoriously opaque and remain hard to interpret. We present ALOE (ALign Once to Explain), a one-time, label-free feature alignment approach that efficiently converts foundational vision models into inherently interpretable B-cos variants. Once aligned, the B-cos backbone is used as a drop-in replacement across several downstream tasks-amortizing the cost of interpretability. ALOE is robust across pre-training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, vision-language) and can preserve teacher-level generalization with orders of magnitude less data than training from scratch. On classification, it strongly outperforms vanilla B-cosification (e.g., +10.5 p.p. top-1 on ImageNet for DINOv3 ViT-B/16), retains strong linear probing, k-NN, and zero-shot transfer competitive with foundational backbones (DINOv3, SigLIP2) across diverse downstream datasets. It also preserves spatially structured features useful for dense prediction, while yielding well-localized and highly human-interpretable explanations by design.

ai_summary.problem: 基础视觉模型性能强但高度不透明、难以解释，且现有可解释化方法成本高、难以扩展到大规模预训练模型。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ALOE（ALign Once to Explain），一种一次性、无标签的特征对齐方法，将基础视觉模型高效转换为内在可解释的 B-cos 变体；对齐后的 B-cos 主干可作为下游任务的即插即用替代，分摊可解释性成本。
ai_summary.result: ALOE 适用于监督、自监督和视觉-语言预训练范式，且用远少于从头训练的数据保持教师级泛化；在分类上显著优于原始 B-cosification（如 DINOv3 ViT-B/16 的 ImageNet top-1 提升 10.5 个百分点），并保留线性探测、k-NN、零样本迁移及密集预测所需的空间结构特征，同时生成定位良好、人类可解释的解释。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过一次性无标签特征对齐实现基础视觉 Transformer 的可扩展 B-cos 化，在保持泛化性能的同时赋予模型内在可解释性。
ai_summary.relevance: 降低了为强大基础视觉模型提供可解释性的成本，使可解释模型更可能在实际视觉任务中大规模部署。

papers.title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态LLM选择题基准的评分规则通常隐藏在代码中，未经论证和审查，却直接决定模型公布的准确率，可能导致评测结果不可靠。
ai_summary.method: 复现8个同行评审基准在5个可在单张16GB GPU上运行的开源视觉语言模型上的官方评分器，并采用盲审的人+LLM评审裁决（Cohen's kappa=0.956）还原模型真实答案，系统比较不同评分规则对准确率的影响。
ai_summary.result: 在相同输出下，仅评分规则就能使准确率最多波动22个百分点；当模型输出干净选项字母时差异为零，因此该问题在强模型排行榜上被掩盖。没有一种标准规则可靠，论文主张基准应报告不合规率并采用至少两种评分规则。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统审计并量化了多模态LLM基准评分器选择对评测结果的影响，揭示“评分规则本身”而非模型能力可能主导排行榜。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作对多模态LLM评测方法论有重要意义，提醒社区关注评分器有效性与基准结果的可复现性。
ai_summary.org: 未提供

papers.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于VLM的零样本机器人任务进度估计容易产生确认偏差和幻觉，把失败执行误判为有进展；直接提示前沿模型又往往退化为二元成功检测器，难以刻画细粒度、非线性进度。
ai_summary.method: 提出D&A（Describe & Assess），将进度估计解耦为两步：先对场景动态生成客观、任务锚定的文本描述，再用显式评分标准进行评估；在打分前强制VLM合成绝对成功的明确定义，从而把评估锚定到外部全局标准而非视频内部时间线。
ai_summary.result: 方法能校准零样本估计并缓解确认偏差，提供细粒度部分进度指标，准确惩罚失败执行并正确插值成功过程；作为纯提示方法可跨任务、具身形态和基准泛化，匹配或超过后训练奖励模型，并支持下游强化学习。
ai_summary.novelty: 用纯提示方式将“描述”和“评估”解耦，并引入显式成功评分标准来避免相对时间排序和隐含成功假设带来的偏差。
ai_summary.relevance: 提升了VLM作为零样本机器人奖励模型的可靠性，对具身智能、机器人强化学习和多模态推理评估有直接意义。

papers.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence. From a low-frame-rate global preview, Reviso constructs a hierarchical Context--Focus--Points (CFP) observation plan that identifies the video context, prioritizes key aspects, and defines concrete observation targets and corresponding tools. Guided by this plan, Reviso performs goal-directed active perception by selectively revisiting temporal segments and combining tools for fine-grained inspection. It interprets the acquired evidence, updates its plan as needed, and integrates global and local information to generate the final caption. To learn this observation strategy, we develop a verification-guided pipeline that constructs high-quality training trajectories through factual verification and teacher-guided refinement. We further train Reviso using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a key-fact reward for caption quality, a Plan Alignment Reward (PAR) for identifying important observation targets, and an Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP) that adjusts observation-cost penalties based on caption quality. Experiments across four video captioning benchmarks show that Reviso outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines, while its generated captions better support downstream video question answering. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of priority-guided active observation for video captioning.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在视频描述中往往过度关注次要细节，而忽略关键上下文和核心事件；论文要解决如何根据视频内容有选择地收集和利用视觉证据的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Reviso 智能体式视频描述框架，从低帧率全局预览构建 Context–Focus–Points（CFP）分层观察计划，并通过选择性回看时间段和调用工具进行目标导向的主动感知。采用验证引导流程构建高质量训练轨迹，并用 GRPO 结合关键事实奖励、计划对齐奖励（PAR）和低效工具调用惩罚（UTCP）训练模型。
ai_summary.result: 在四个视频描述基准上，Reviso 优于所评估的开源基线，且生成的描述能更好地支持下游视频问答任务。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是让模型学习“什么值得看、如何看”的优先级引导主动观察策略，并通过带计划对齐和工具调用成本约束的强化学习优化视频描述。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明面向视频的 MLLM 可通过主动、目标导向的视觉证据选择提升描述质量，对多模态 Agent、视频理解和高效感知具有参考价值。

papers.title: Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态检索中，样本内各模态可能缺失、噪声大或信息量不均，现有基于样本内对齐的目标无法显式利用语义相关样本间的互补信息，限制了检索表示学习。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种仅在训练时使用的超图融合框架，将样本内观测模态与跨语义相关样本的模态连接起来进行表示学习；包含HyVol特例，并给出wHyVol和wRHG两种配置，后者通过关系传播建模类型化交互与参与者角色，缺失模态直接省略而非插补，训练后丢弃超图，不增加推理成本。
ai_summary.result: 在11个零样本视频-文本和音频-文本检索基准上取得广泛提升；在17个视频基准-模态设置的双向检索中，wRHG在34项比较中全部优于GRAM、33/34优于HyperGRAM；文本到视频平均R@1从63.4提升到68.2（GRAM）和从64.8到68.4（HyperGRAM），ActivityNet上视频到文本最大提升13.3个百分点；缺失模态下仍保持正向增益，即使90%片段缺失一个模态。
ai_summary.novelty: 将超图正则化用于训练期跨样本多模态融合，在不改变推理流程、不增加推理成本的前提下显式利用语义相关样本的互补证据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态检索提供了一种低成本、可插拔的训练期表示增强思路，对缺失模态鲁棒性和跨样本语义对齐研究有参考价值。

papers.title: Neural Actor--Critic Learning with Minimax Critics and Reflected Langevin Sampling
papers.abstract: Actor--critic methods rely on critic gradients to improve continuous-action policies, yet finite-sample guarantees must control both value and gradient errors and their propagation through the actor. We develop a neural actor-critic procedure that combines a regularized minimax Bellman estimator over sigmoid networks with a finite reflected Langevin sampler driven by the fitted critic gradient. Under uniform Bellman regularity and covered reset sampling, a positive high-order action-derivative penalty yields value and action-gradient risk bounds with classical nonparametric minimax exponents up to logarithmic factors. We propagate estimation, mixing, discretization, temperature, and policy-iteration errors to obtain return guarantees, with refinements for bounded multimodal potentials and strongly concave regimes. Empirical studies across controlled simulations, logged continuous-control data, and a simulated decision task show favorable performance relative to the considered baselines.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文研究连续动作强化学习中的神经 actor-critic 方法，旨在建立同时控制价值函数误差、动作梯度误差及其在 actor 中传播的有限样本理论保证。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出一种神经 actor-critic 流程：在 sigmoid 网络上使用正则化 minimax Bellman 估计器学习 critic，并用由拟合 critic 梯度驱动的有限反射 Langevin 采样器更新连续动作策略；同时引入高阶动作导数惩罚。理论分析将估计、混合、离散化、温度和策略迭代误差逐项传播，从而得到回报保证。
ai_summary.result: 在均匀 Bellman 正则性和覆盖式 reset 采样等条件下，方法得到价值与动作梯度风险界，达到经典非参数 minimax 指数（最多相差对数因子），并进一步给出有界多峰势和强凹情形下的细化结果；实验在受控模拟、日志连续控制数据和模拟决策任务上优于所比较的基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新在于将正则化 minimax 神经 critic 估计、反射 Langevin 策略采样以及端到端有限样本误差传播统一到一个可证明的 actor-critic 框架中。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为神经 actor-critic 在连续控制中的统计与算法可靠性提供了更完整的理论基础，有助于理解 critic 梯度误差如何影响策略优化与最终回报。

papers.title: MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
papers.abstract: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: when given a correct caption in a non-English language and an incorrect one in English, models preferentially select the English caption. This bias varies considerably across architectures. Among the tested models, Gemma 3 shows the strongest English preference while Qwen 3 is the least biased, despite both reaching similar monolingual accuracy across languages. The code is available at https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型在细粒度图像细节理解上表现不足，且这种缺陷在多语言场景下会被进一步放大；现有缺乏覆盖多语种的细粒度视觉理解基准。
ai_summary.method: 将英语细粒度数据集 InpaintCOCO 扩展到 13 种语言、5 个语系，构建包含 953 个最小对比样本的多语言基准 MultiInpaintCOCO；并评测多种多模态检索模型，包括类 CLIP 轻量编码器和大语言模型。
ai_summary.result: 低资源语言性能显著下降，语言可用数据资源比与英语的类型学相似性更能预测表现；跨语言检索中多数模型存在英语偏好，Gemma 3 最明显，Qwen 3 偏见最小。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了面向细粒度视觉细节的多语言最小对比基准，并系统揭示多模态检索中的英语偏好及其架构差异。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多语言视觉语言模型的细粒度理解、公平性和跨语言偏见评估提供了重要诊断工具。

papers.title: VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Many manipulation goals are easier to visualize than to specify numerically through explicit geometric constraints. We present VerifLM, a framework that converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for planning. Using an edited image, VerifLM recovers an initial relative pose between an active object and a passive object, then prompts a vision-language model to generate axis-wise sampling constraints and a task-specific validation program. Candidate poses are evaluated in a physics simulator, and the VLM selects the most task-consistent retained candidate. To operate without predefined object meshes or physical parameters, VerifLM reconstructs metric object geometry from RGB-D observations and constructs multiple hypothetical simulations with varying physics and geometry. Parallel-world validation evaluates candidates across geometry--physics variations and ranks them by the number of worlds in which they satisfy the validation program. We evaluate VerifLM on nine manipulation tasks. VerifLM achieves the highest task success on eight of nine tasks, with the largest performance gain on goals requiring precise orientation and contact relationships.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人操作任务中，许多目标状态难以用显式几何约束精确指定，但从图像中更容易可视化。论文要解决如何将图像编辑得到的目标配置转化为物理可行、可用于规划的6-DoF物体位姿。
ai_summary.method: VerifLM首先从编辑图像中恢复主动物体与被动对象之间的初始相对位姿，并让视觉语言模型生成轴方向采样约束和任务验证程序；随后在物理仿真中评估候选位姿，并由VLM选择最符合任务要求的候选。为摆脱预定义网格和物理参数，方法从RGB-D观测重建度量几何，并构建多组不同物理与几何假设的平行仿真世界，按满足验证程序的世界数量对候选排序。
ai_summary.result: 在九个机器人操作任务上，VerifLM在八个任务中取得最高任务成功率，尤其在需要精确方向和接触关系的目标上提升最大。
ai_summary.novelty: 将图像编辑目标、VLM生成约束与验证程序、以及多世界物理仿真验证结合，实现无需预定义物体网格或物理参数的目标位姿生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了视觉语言模型与物理仿真结合用于机器人目标位姿生成和规划的潜力，对具身智能与机器人操作有参考价值。

papers.title: R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation
papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

ai_summary.problem: Omni-LLM 处理大量音视频多模态 token 时计算成本和 KV cache 内存开销很高；激进 token 剪枝虽在多选题上有效，但会显著降低长文本开放式生成质量。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练的 R²-Omni 框架：先用结构感知 token 合并（STC）利用视频时空相似性和音频局部连续性合并冗余表示；再用语义敏感精度分配（SSPA）根据量化 key 下注意力输出误差降低程度，为保留表示分配 value 精度，并以 query attention 和音视频对齐作为语义先验。
ai_summary.result: 在长文本生成基准上平均减少 5.0× 内存占用，保留 97.98% 的基线生成质量，并实现 1.48× 端到端加速。
ai_summary.novelty: 联合降低 Omni-LLM token 表示中的结构冗余和精度冗余，且无需训练即可提升长文本生成效率。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型长文本生成中的 KV cache 压缩与高效推理提供了新思路。

papers.title: Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts
papers.abstract: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决多模态测试时适应中由模态可靠性偏移（信息质量下降）和模态可用性偏移（模态缺失）带来的鲁棒性问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出自适应概率高斯校准（AdaPGC），将类别条件高斯建模扩展到模态特定表示和多模态融合表示，并持续更新高斯模型；利用概率预测校准源模型预测、指导基于可靠性的修正，并通过联合分布恢复不可用的融合表示。
ai_summary.result: 在多种模态损坏和缺失条件下，AdaPGC 能有效提升模型在模态可靠性偏移和可用性偏移下的鲁棒性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将类别条件高斯概率校准同时用于模态特定表示与融合表示，并利用联合分布恢复缺失融合表示，以统一处理多模态测试时适应中的可靠性与可用性偏移。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升多模态模型在真实部署中面对分布偏移和模态缺失时的可靠性与适应能力。
ai_summary.org: 北京大学（依据作者信息推断，原文未给出机构信息）

papers.title: PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.

ai_summary.problem: 准确的作物健康诊断依赖专家知识且难以及时获得，而视觉语言模型虽然具备视觉理解与自然语言交互能力，却因计算和内存需求高难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PlantVLM-Edge 量化视觉语言框架，结合农业领域适配、训练后量化和离线设备端服务，使种植者可进行开放式对话式诊断。框架与主干模型无关，并在 Qwen3-VL-2B 和 LLaVA-1.5-7B、四种量化方案、病虫害两个诊断域及 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上验证。
ai_summary.result: 8-bit 量化对答案质量影响很小；4-bit AWQ 在两个诊断域上保留 98.6% 的全精度答案质量，并将 2B 主干权重内存降低 49%。最紧凑配置仅需 2.01 GiB 权重内存，首 token 约 0.12 秒，64-token 诊断响应约 0.78 秒。
ai_summary.novelty: 面向作物健康对话诊断，系统性地验证了领域适配、多种量化方案和多类 VLM 主干在边缘设备上的端到端可部署性。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了多模态大模型在农业边缘设备上的实用化路径，为下一代作物监测与决策支持系统提供了可复现的部署基础。

papers.title: Exploring Proximity and Tactile Sensing for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pre-touch sensing, or sensing information about an object before contact, is an attractive modality for robot hands as it can allow a robot to anticipate and respond to a contact before it happens. In this work, we introduce ToFTouch, a multimodal tactile sensor combining three multizone (4$\times$4 resolution) time-of-flight sensors with an optics-based pressure sensing array. We mount this sensor on a parallel jaw gripper and demonstrate its utility on three distinct tasks: (i) pre-grasp adjustment, (ii) item extraction from clutter, and (iii) item insertion into tight spaces. For pre-grasp adjustment, ToF feedback reduced cycle time by 7.4$\%$ by enabling anticipatory gripper closure during approach. For extraction, ToF sensing enabled successful retrieval across all tested depth offsets ($\pm$2 cm) deviating from the nominal pick point, including conditions where baseline approaches failed, with standard deviations below 0.4 cm. For insertion into dense clutter, we explore the proximity and tactile information provided from ToFTouch during an insertion trajectory. The results demonstrate the utility of multizone ToF sensing in a manipulation environment.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决机器人操作中接触前感知的问题，即如何让机械手在接触物体之前预判并响应，从而提升抓取和操作性能。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 ToFTouch，一种多模态触觉传感器，将三个 4×4 分辨率的飞行时间（ToF）传感器与基于光学的压力传感阵列结合，并安装在平行夹爪上。系统在预抓取调整、杂乱环境中取物、狭窄空间插入三个任务上进行了验证。
ai_summary.result: ToF 反馈使预抓取阶段的周期时间减少 7.4%；在取物任务中，即使偏离标准抓取点 ±2 cm 也能成功，标准差低于 0.4 cm；在密集杂乱环境插入任务中，邻近与触觉信息对轨迹执行有帮助。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多区域 ToF 邻近传感与光学压力阵列集成到机器人夹爪中，实现接触前预判与接触感知的多模态融合。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了邻近与触觉传感融合在机器人操作中的实用价值，有助于提升机器人在杂乱和受限环境中的感知与操作鲁棒性。
ai_summary.org: Columbia University

papers.title: EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation
papers.abstract: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.

ai_summary.problem: 地球观测（EO）任务需要从已知候选中做选择、估计置信度并处理海量影像，而生成式视觉语言模型自回归解码代价高、置信度不可靠；决策模型虽能单次前向给出候选概率，但其在EO任务上的准确性、校准与迁移性尚不清楚。
ai_summary.method: 作者先对8.4B参数的决策模型d3-flash在23个公开EO基准的30个设置上做诊断性研究，分析其推理、校准与任务迁移表现；随后在公开EO训练集上用低秩微调将其适配为EO-Jev，以弥补计数、变化量化、损毁分级和缺失目标识别等短板。
ai_summary.result: EO-Jev在30个设置中的26个上显著优于d3-flash，在28个中的20个上达到或超过专家专用模型，12个留出设置平均提升8.0分，28个设置中有21个的期望校准误差低于专家模型，仅以通用决策性能下降1.8分为代价。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统评估通用决策模型在EO多任务上的准确率、校准与迁移性，并证明轻量适配即可将通用决策模型转为有竞争力的EO通才模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态决策模型（非自回归、单次前向、可校准）在遥感等专业领域的落地提供了实证依据，并指出定量感知、选项顺序一致性与分布偏移下校准等仍待解决的问题。
ai_summary.org: 提供的作者信息中未附机构；从作者名单（Salman Khan、Fahad Shahbaz Khan等）推断可能为MBZUAI（穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学）团队，另有Linköping University合作者。

papers.title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
papers.abstract: **Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity.   **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses.   **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance.   **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.

ai_summary.problem: 超声生物测量依赖医生手动放置卡尺，存在操作者间差异；现有视觉语言模型直接预测坐标，未显式建模空间似然分布，难以表达定位歧义。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Kev-Bio，一种视觉语言模型，用临床测量问题引导超声关键点检测；利用语言模型的决策表示生成每个卡尺端点的查询，与共享的稠密超声特征匹配，得到空间概率图，并从中导出关键点坐标和临床测量值，端到端联合训练关键点定位与临床测量损失。
ai_summary.result: 在九视图 FU/GU Biometry 2026 数据集上，Kev-Bio 达到 22.50 像素的平均径向误差和 15.38 的临床测量平均绝对误差，整体性能优于对比基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 将语言模型的决策表示转化为查询，与共享稠密视觉特征匹配生成空间概率图，从而显式建模超声关键点定位的不确定性。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了视觉语言模型结合空间概率建模在医学超声定量测量中的潜力，为多视图超声关键点检测和临床测量提供可推广范式。
ai_summary.org: 未能识别（摘要未提供作者机构信息）

papers.title: Evaluating Depth-Augmented Visual Features for Cross-Dataset Lunar Traversability Estimation
papers.abstract: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Although recent traversability estimation methods increasingly rely on deep learning, the domain gap between terrestrial analogue environments and real lunar terrain can limit their generalisation, and real lunar traversability labels are scarce, making fully supervised training difficult. To address these challenges, we build a weakly supervised framework trained on sparse pairwise annotations and study whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information: depth, surface normals, and combined geometric descriptors. We evaluate the models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings using two terrestrial analogue datasets and the real lunar Chang'E PCAM dataset. Contrary to expectations, we find that naive geometric augmentation yields no consistent improvement over a strong visual-only baseline in either setting, with effects small relative to seed-to-seed variance. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Our evaluation runs onboard a resource-constrained edge device and provides a controlled baseline for designing more expressive multimodal fusion architectures in future lunar perception systems.

ai_summary.problem: 月面自主通行性估计受通信延迟和遮挡限制，而真实月面标签稀缺，且地球类比环境与真实月面存在域差距，需评估深度/几何增强视觉特征能否提升跨数据集泛化。
ai_summary.method: 构建基于稀疏成对标注的弱监督框架，比较纯视觉基线与加入深度、表面法线及组合几何描述子的多模态特征；在两个地球类比数据集和嫦娥PCAM真实月面数据集上进行域内与跨域评估，并部署到资源受限边缘设备。
ai_summary.result: 简单的几何增强并未在域内或跨域设置中稳定优于强纯视觉基线，提升幅度相对于随机种子方差较小；训练数据源的选择对迁移到真实月面影像的影响远大于几何融合策略。
ai_summary.novelty: 在弱监督和跨数据集设置下系统评估深度增强视觉特征对月面通行性估计的价值，并给出面向真实嫦娥数据的受控基线。
ai_summary.relevance: 为月球/空间机器人多模态感知与融合架构设计提供实证参考，提醒几何融合并非默认有效，数据源选择更关键。

papers.title: Toward Uncertainty-Aware, Physics-Grounded Human World Models
papers.abstract: A robot that acts around people needs a world model of the human: a belief over the person's body state and a dynamics model that predicts where that state goes next. This abstract argues that two published components form exactly these two halves, and specifies how to couple them. KNOWN [1] reconstructs the 3D human body while estimating both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in real time (11.6 ms per frame); its aleatoric term identifies unreliable observations, its epistemic term identifies inputs from low-density regions of the training data, and refinement driven by the epistemic term reduces the error on such inputs from 81.3 to 70.3 mm. PhysMoP [2] predicts future body configuration by solving the Euler-Lagrange equations of the body with learned dynamics terms, reducing the 80 ms prediction error from 9.6 to 2.1 mm on Human3.6M and from 12.1 to 0.7 mm on 3DPW. We define the interface between the two, propose three mechanisms by which KNOWN's uncertainty enters PhysMoP, and specify an evaluation protocol on in-the-wild video. No new experimental results are reported here.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人围绕人行动时需要关于人的世界模型，即对人体状态及其不确定性的信念，以及能预测未来身体状态的动力学模型；本文要解决如何将这两部分耦合起来。
ai_summary.method: 提出将实时3D人体重建与不确定性估计方法KNOWN作为状态信念模块，将基于欧拉-拉格朗日方程和学习动力学项的PhysMoP作为未来预测模块；定义二者接口，提出三种让KNOWN的不确定性进入PhysMoP的机制，并设计野外视频评测协议。
ai_summary.result: 本文没有报告新的实验结果；引用已有结果说明KNOWN可实时估计偶然与认知不确定性并以认知不确定性驱动 refinement，PhysMoP可显著降低未来人体配置预测误差。主要结论是这两个组件可组合成不确定性感知、物理约束的人体世界模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 主要创新在于提出不确定性感知的人体状态估计与物理 grounded 动力学预测之间的接口和三种不确定性耦合机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 对具身智能和机器人中的人类建模、安全交互与世界模型研究有方向性意义，但尚缺新实验验证。
ai_summary.org: 无法识别（作者未提供机构信息）

papers.title: ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting
papers.abstract: Geospatial text spotting involves locating and transcribing geographic labels, such as road names, district names, and landmarks, in raster maps. These labels are often small, densely arranged, and arbitrarily oriented. Although Arabic text recognition has been studied extensively in documents and natural scenes, Arabic geospatial text spotting remains underexplored. We introduce ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic-centric benchmark covering 970 geographic locations in Riyadh and Jeddah, with 17,875 manually annotated text instances per view type. For each location, we pair an OpenStreetMap (OSM) rendering with a composite created by overlaying that rendering on the corresponding remote sensing (RS) imagery. The paired views preserve label content and pixel geometry, allowing evaluation across different backgrounds. Geographic partitions support in-city and city-disjoint evaluation of detection, recognition, and end-to-end spotting. Experiments with direct Qwen3.5-4B spotting show difficulties in recovering all labels within a tile. We therefore propose a tool-augmented vision-language framework that combines YOLO26 localization and crop rectification with Qwen3.5-4B recognition adapted through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The framework outperforms direct LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B spotting across both image views and test cities. With localization held fixed, reader adaptation further improves recognition over the pretrained zero-shot reader. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ArabGeoText.

ai_summary.problem: 阿拉伯语地理空间文本定位（在地图栅格中定位并转写路名、区域名、地标等小尺寸、密集、任意朝向的标注）研究严重不足，现有视觉语言模型难以完整识别单个图块内的所有标签。
ai_summary.method: 构建 ARABGEOTEXT 基准：覆盖利雅得和吉达 970 个地理位置，每种视图 17,875 个人工标注文本实例，将 OSM 渲染图与叠加在遥感影像上的合成图配对，并按地理分区支持城内与跨城评测。提出工具增强的视觉语言框架：先用 YOLO26 做定位与裁剪矫正，再用经 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3.5-4B 做识别。
ai_summary.result: 该框架在两种图像视图和两个测试城市上均优于直接使用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3.5-4B 端到端定位；在固定定位模块的前提下，读者模型适配也较零样本预训练读者带来识别提升。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出以阿拉伯语为中心的地理空间文本定位基准，并用“检测器定位+裁剪矫正+LoRA 识别器”的工具增强范式替代端到端 VLM 定位。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在遥感/地图理解、低资源语言场景下的工具增强与基准评测提供了可复用的数据与思路。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构字段为空，仅列出姓名）

papers.title: EventGPT: Next-Event Pretraining on Banking Customer Histories
papers.abstract: A model pretrained to predict a customer's next event can estimate the probability of future events without training on their labels and provide a reusable representation for supervised downstream banking tasks. We pretrain EventGPT, a hierarchical causal transformer, by next-token maximum likelihood estimation on the public Multimodal Banking Dataset (MBD-mini: 100,224 clients, 38.8 million transactions and 66.3 million geolocation pings). Keeping one state per event, EventGPT trains in about two hours on one L4 GPU at windows up to 8,192 tokens. From its next-event distribution, with no labels, EventGPT scores five targets of the form "the client makes a transaction of a given kind for the first time next month" at ROC-AUC 0.79 to 0.92. Gradient boosting on 114 engineered features needs 10,000 to 300,000 labeled client-months to match it on four targets and stays below it on the fifth. For product prediction, frozen EventGPT embeddings score below the engineered features (mean ROC-AUC 0.787 against 0.808 over five test folds), and a rank-averaged ensemble of EventGPT, profile fields and token counts with the engineered features adds 0.014 to 0.017, of which 0.007 to 0.016 is EventGPT's own. The code and pretrained weights are released.

ai_summary.problem: 银行客户行为序列的监督学习任务依赖大量人工特征工程与标注数据，论文探索能否用「预测下一个事件」的自监督预训练，在无标签条件下获得可复用的客户行为表征并完成下游任务。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 EventGPT——一个分层因果 Transformer，在公开多模态银行数据集 MBD-mini（10万客户、3880万条交易、6630万条地理定位）上以「下一 token 最大似然」进行事件级预训练，每个事件只保留一个状态，单张 L4 GPU 约两小时即可训练（窗口最长 8192 token）。其下一事件分布可直接用于零样本打分，冻结的嵌入也可接入下游模型或与其他特征做排序集成。
ai_summary.result: 在五个「客户下月首次发生某类交易」的预测目标上，EventGPT 不做任何标签训练即达到 ROC-AUC 0.79–0.92，而梯度提升需 1 万至 30 万条有标签客户-月样本才能在四个目标上追平、第五个目标仍落后。冻结嵌入单独使用略逊于 114 维人工特征（平均 0.787 对 0.808），但与画像字段、token 计数及人工特征做排序平均集成后可提升 0.014–0.017，其中 0.007–0.016 来自 EventGPT 本身。代码与预训练权重已开源。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统验证「下一事件预测」式自监督预训练在真实银行客户行为序列上的零样本预测能力与表征复用价值，并给出与强特征工程基线的量化对比。
ai_summary.relevance: 为金融等强结构化、事件流式的行业提供了一条以自监督预训练替代大规模标注与手工特征的可行路径，也丰富了事件序列世界模型/序列建模的实证案例。
ai_summary.org: 未标注所属机构（仅一位独立作者 Denis Burakov）

papers.title: Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data
papers.abstract: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture selected outputs, such as rendered video, images, and depth maps, at a specified resolution and frame rate under selected rendering and camera configurations. Separating simulation from capture allows the same recorded gameplay to produce multiple output variants without repeating the original simulation. Visual outputs are accompanied by frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata. The platform uploads generated data directly in a training-friendly format, reducing intermediate storage, preparation time, and manual processing. This report describes the design of our overall system, including the platform's assets, plugins, and their functionality, explaining how they work together to generate diverse synthetic gameplay data.

ai_summary.problem: 为视觉与世界模型、神经图形和游戏智能体等研究提供多样化、带帧对齐标注的合成3D游戏视觉数据。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Isekai3D SDG 平台，结合可复用环境/角色资产与 Unreal Engine 插件，采用“两阶段”流程：先模拟游戏并记录世界状态、角色动作和相机轨迹，再回放录制结果以指定分辨率和帧率渲染视频、图像、深度图等。
ai_summary.result: 同一段录制游戏可生成多种输出变体而无需重复模拟，并直接以训练友好格式上传数据，减少中间存储、准备时间和人工处理，同时提供帧对齐的相机、角色和动作元数据。
ai_summary.novelty: 将模拟与捕获分离，从而高效复用同一游戏录制生成多配置、多模态的合成数据。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于降低世界模型、具身智能体和神经图形研究中对多样化合成游戏数据与标注的获取成本。
ai_summary.org: 未知

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日 20 篇论文中有 15 篇属于多模态方向，几乎形成单一主导方向。研究重心正从“看懂”转向“可执行、可验证”：TAMPAgent、D&A、VerifLM 等将 VLM/LVLM 直接接入机器人规划、奖励生成与物理仿真验证闭环；同时出现对评测环节的反省（评分器审计、多语言细粒度基准），以及免训练效率优化（R²-Omni 冗余削减、超图对齐、B-cos 化可解释性）。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日数据中大厂论文分布为空，各论文的 orgs 字段也未提供机构信息，因此无法识别大厂之间的方向重合或方法竞争关系。从选题风格看，具身操作（TAMPAgent、VerifLM、PlantVLM-Edge）与多模态评测审计更接近高校/研究院路线，边缘量化作物诊断则偏应用落地。待机构元数据补齐后，才能判断是否存在同题竞争。
daily_insight.signals: 值得注意的三个信号：1）多模态论文占比达 75%，方向过度集中，其他赛道（世界模型仅 2 篇、Agent 独立选题稀少）显得稀疏；2）“VLM + 物理/仿真验证”成为机器人落地的新范式，4 篇论文不约而同引入验证程序或多世界物理仿真，说明纯端到端生成正被“生成+校验”替代；3）评测可信度首次作为独立问题被系统审计（Same Outputs, Different Scores），提示榜单结论可能被评分规则主导，是容易被忽视的风险点。
daily_insight.overlap_topic: 无（今日未采集到大厂论文，无可比对的重合方向）
